rapport_notes: Stayed polite and calm under pushback but never really recovered the sale.

evidence_quotes.agenda: "Let's talk about your move first. What are your biggest concerns and what are the most important things you want answers to on this call today?" - asked right after quid pro quo, before probing
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: Customer's stated concern ("I just got an instant quote online... I thought the quote was really high") got only a generic re-explanation of the stairs-driven time estimate, not real digging
evidence_quotes.save_your_ass: not covered - customer pushed back on price and rep never deployed any of the five lines

top_strength: Opened with a strong quid pro quo tying the accurate-estimate promise directly to the customer's stated frustration with the online instant quote.
coaching_note: When the customer pushed back that the estimate was 'too much,' the rep re-explained the math but never used the Save Your Ass lines (rate commitment, window framing, if-the-crew-beats-it) built for exactly this moment - likely why the call was lost.
